newsitem.title: DENMARK: Danish shares rebound on Wall Street gains.
newsitem.headline: Danish shares rebound on Wall Street gains.

text.p: Danish share prices predictably tracked Wall Street up on Thursday morning and dealers said that the strong dollar and falling bond yields augured well for further Danish stock gains throughout the day.
At 0740 GMT the KFX top-20 index stood at 155.16, up 0.39 point from Wednesday's close.
Its June future was up 0.40 point to 156.10.
Among the top-20 shares A.P. Moeller's D/S Svendborg and D/S 1912 were expected to gain from a forecast 16.5 percent rise in North Sea oil and gas production in 1997.
